## Audit and fix of the neutrino-mass proof (rm-13586-1)

I reviewed solution.tex in full. It correctly and rigorously addresses all four sub-goals (P0 no-go, P1 classification, P2 Weinberg/seesaw, P3 0vbb discriminator). I verified the key technical claims and repaired the one genuine rigor gap.

### Verified numerically/symbolically
- Spinor identities (Weyl basis): with C = i*gamma^2*gamma^0, confirmed C gamma_mu^T C^{-1} = -gamma_mu, C^T=-C, C^dag C = 1, and the chirality-flip identity (P_L psi)^c = P_R psi^c used in eq.(flip). All exact.
- One-generation seesaw (Lemma seesaw): eigenvalues {-m_D^2/M, M+m_D^2/M} and light-eigenvector admixture -m_D/M confirmed to stated orders (sympy series + numpy).
- General-flavor seesaw (Thm seesaw): light masses from the full 6x6 diagonalization match eigenvalues of -m_D M^{-1} m_D^T to machine precision.

### Fix applied
The original proof of the general-flavor seesaw theorem used a hand-wavy congruence W=exp(Theta) with several entries written as "..." and a dubious "+2(lower order)" step. I replaced it with a FULLY EXPLICIT, EXACT derivation:

Using the lower-triangular congruence W = [[1,0],[B,1]],
  W^T M W = [[ B^T m_D^T + m_D B + B^T M B ,  m_D + B^T M ],[ m_D^T + M B ,  M ]].
The unique choice B = -M^{-1} m_D^T makes the off-diagonal blocks vanish IDENTICALLY (not merely to O(rho^2)); the heavy block is exactly M; the light block collapses to exactly
  -m_D M^{-1} m_D^T - m_D M^{-1} m_D^T + m_D M^{-1} m_D^T = -m_D M^{-1} m_D^T.
Verified numerically: off-diagonal blocks exactly zero, light block = -m_D M^{-1} m_D^T, heavy block = M (machine precision). The integrate-out (EOM) derivation is kept as an independent cross-check, with O(||m_D M^{-1}||^2) corrections from passing to the unitary mass basis noted.

All theorem/proof/equation environments and braces balanced. No LaTeX toolchain is installed in the sandbox so compilation was skipped, but the source is structurally consistent.

### Conclusion
The proof is rigorous end to end. Determination: the SM forbids a renormalizable neutrino mass; the missing second chirality is supplied either by new gauge-singlet nu_R (Dirac, L-conserving) or by (nu_L)^c (Majorana, Delta L = 2, dim-5 Weinberg op / seesaw); and 0vbb (rate proportional to |<m_bb>|^2, <m_bb>=|sum_i U_ei^2 m_i|) is the discriminator, nonzero iff a Majorana mass component exists (Schechter-Valle). Resolving.
